name: Lyo.Api.FileStorage.Models
tagline: HTTP request and response DTOs for the file-storage API. No dependency on Lyo.FileStorage.
description: HTTP request and response DTOs for the file-storage API. `Lyo.Api.FileStorage` maps these onto `IFileStorageService`. Clients (`Lyo.FileStorage.Web.Components`) send them over `IApiClient` and do not reference the storage engine.
